:::{#thm-aic-lrt}
#### Information criteria as likelihood ratio thresholds

Let model $M_0$ be nested in model $M_1$,
with $M_1$ having $k$ more parameters than $M_0$,
both fit by maximum likelihood to the same $n$ observations,
and let
$G^2 \eqdef 2\paren{\est{\llik}_1 - \est{\llik}_0}$
be the [likelihood ratio test statistic](logistic-regression.qmd#def-lrt-statistic) comparing them.
Then

$$
\text{AIC}_1 < \text{AIC}_0
\quad \text{if and only if} \quad
G^2 > 2k
$$

and

$$
\text{BIC}_1 < \text{BIC}_0
\quad \text{if and only if} \quad
G^2 > k \logf{n}
$$

:::

::: proof
Let $M_0$ have $p$ parameters, so $M_1$ has $p + k$.
For AIC:

$$
\ba
\text{AIC}_0 - \text{AIC}_1
&= \paren{-2 \est{\llik}_0 + 2p} - \paren{-2 \est{\llik}_1 + 2(p + k)}
&& \text{(AIC formula for each model)} \\
&= 2 \est{\llik}_1 - 2 \est{\llik}_0 + 2p - 2p - 2k
&& \text{(distribute the subtraction)} \\
&= 2\paren{\est{\llik}_1 - \est{\llik}_0} - 2k
&& \text{(cancel } 2p \text{; factor out 2)} \\
&= G^2 - 2k
&& \text{(definition of } G^2 \text{)}
\ea
$$

so $\text{AIC}_1 < \text{AIC}_0$
exactly when $G^2 - 2k > 0$,
that is, when $G^2 > 2k$.
The BIC calculation is the same
with each penalty $2$ replaced by $\logf{n}$:

$$
\ba
\text{BIC}_0 - \text{BIC}_1
&= \paren{-2 \est{\llik}_0 + p \logf{n}} - \paren{-2 \est{\llik}_1 + (p + k) \logf{n}}
&& \text{(BIC formula for each model)} \\
&= 2 \est{\llik}_1 - 2 \est{\llik}_0 + p \logf{n} - p \logf{n} - k \logf{n}
&& \text{(distribute the subtraction)} \\
&= 2\paren{\est{\llik}_1 - \est{\llik}_0} - k \logf{n}
&& \text{(cancel } p \logf{n} \text{; factor out 2)} \\
&= G^2 - k \logf{n}
&& \text{(definition of } G^2 \text{)}
\ea
$$

so $\text{BIC}_1 < \text{BIC}_0$ exactly when $G^2 > k \logf{n}$.
:::
